timezone: America/Los_Angeles; fixed UTC-07:00 during this date range
provenance: Entirely synthetic. Inspired by DERConnect asset types, not fitted to real DERConnect data.
detector: Training-only weekday/weekend slot medians plus within-slot temperature coefficient. Robust scale with 7%/3 kW floor. Validation 99.5th percentile threshold, minimum 3. Missing, 8 repeated intervals, and PF below 0.75 with Q above 1.6x the training slot median are separate illustrative rules.
context_rules: Causal four-reading overnight episodes repeated near the same time within 7 days; and rolling 12-reading daytime windows with mean signed score above a validation-calibrated 99.5th percentile (minimum 1.5) for 3 consecutive checks, at least 10 scores >=0.8, and no point flags. Sequence release uses 80% of the trigger threshold. Context detections start at the evidence trigger, never at the earlier evidence window. Simultaneous missing-data alerts are linked across meters using only detections already available.
